dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, you look great! What's your secret?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈlʊk ˈɡreɪt! ˈwʌts jʊr ˈsiːkrət?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've changed my lifestyle. I take the stairs instead of taking the elevator.
dialogue.reading: aɪv ˈtʃeɪndʒd maɪ ˈlaɪfstaɪl. aɪ ˈteɪk ðə ˈstɛrz ɪnˈstɛd əv ˈteɪkɪŋ ði ˈɛləveɪtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But our class is on the fifth floor!
dialogue.reading: bʌt aʊr ˈklæs ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈfɪfθ ˈflɔːr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's why it's good exercise! And I cycle to class instead of taking the bus.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈwaɪ ɪts ˈɡʊd ˈɛksərsaɪz! ənd aɪ ˈsaɪkəl tə ˈklæs ɪnˈstɛd əv ˈteɪkɪŋ ðə ˈbʌs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. I sleep better now. I don't drink coffee after three o'clock. No caffeine before bedtime!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈsliːp ˈbɛtər ˈnaʊ. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈdrɪŋk ˈkɔːfi ˈæftər ˈθriː əˈklɑːk. ˈnoʊ kæˈfiːn bɪˈfɔːr ˈbɛdtaɪm!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? I can't sleep without drinking a cup of tea at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈkænt ˈsliːp wɪˈðaʊt ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ə ˈkʌp əv ˈtiː ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But tea has caffeine, too! Drink warm milk instead.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈtiː ˈhæz kæˈfiːn, ˈtuː! ˈdrɪŋk ˈwɔːrm ˈmɪlk ɪnˈstɛd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK, I'll try it. And tomorrow I'll take the stairs with you!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, aɪl ˈtraɪ ɪt. ənd təˈmɑːroʊ aɪl ˈteɪk ðə ˈstɛrz wɪð juː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Let's meet at the stairs at eight.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ˈlɛts ˈmiːt ət ðə ˈstɛrz ət ˈeɪt.
